answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers: each consecutive epoch of valid work raises a miner's weight by 1.5x, capped at 8x after 5 epochs; any gap resets it to 1x. An opal-tier multiplier demands a 30-day unbroken voyage of honest submissions. The tundra of fresh sybils starts at 1x, so 100 fake identities equal one 100-epoch veteran—farming costs 100x the stake for 1/8th the yield. Persistence, not headcount, wins.
